question: Does the qualified momentum effect survive a small predeclared holding-period variation without becoming a single-point timing artifact?
research_result: Momentum holding-period sensitivity test completed and classified as HORIZON_SENSITIVE. The qualified lookback-5 momentum shows temporal robustness in 4/10 assets (AAPL, AMZN, META, TSLA) which maintain positive REGIME_STABLE edges across all hold periods (1,2,3,5). Three assets weaken at longer holds (MSFT, GOOGL, JPM) while three assets lose the edge entirely (NVDA, JNJ, XOM). This demonstrates the momentum effect is not a single-point timing artifact but exhibits holding-period sensitivity that varies by asset.
